message.content: {"caption":"Microsoft wordmark with its four-color window symbol.","description":"A Microsoft logo consisting of four equal colored squares arranged as a two-by-two window—orange-red at upper left, green at upper right, blue at lower left, and yellow at lower right—followed by the gray word “Microsoft.” In the page context, the logo identifies Microsoft, the organization associated with the paper.","figure_type":"other","chart_values":[]}
